title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
summary: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
summary: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

title: Bitcoin, ether and solana climb as another $1 billion shorts get wiped out
summary: The two-day short liquidation total has reached about $3.8 billion, after Thursday's figure set a record going back to 2021.

title: A $2 million bet on XRP volatility crosses the tape as prices surge
